capabilities: filter canvas nodes by their color
filter nodes connected to the selection by arrows
restore full canvas visibility by reopening the canvas
extras: Filtering is temporary: hidden nodes stay in place and reopening the canvas restores their visibility.
problem: Obsidian Canvas has no built-in way to temporarily isolate nodes of interest when a canvas gets large and cluttered.
summary: Canvas filter that shows only the nodes matching a selected node's color, its arrow connections, or tags, and hides all others.
